subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Although the tree was gone, it still had something to teach.”?
options: It is part of a larger environment, even when the wild arrives quietly under streetlights.
It showed that Grandpa was willing to enter a new world, one number at a time.
The Warm Wall shows that even quiet people may have something helpful to say.
The rings showed that growth leaves marks, even when no one notices year by year.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Although the tree was gone, it still had something to teach. The rings showed that growth leaves marks, even when no one notices year…」，答案為「The rings showed that growth leaves marks, even when no one notices year by year.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The rings showed that growth leaves marks, even when no one notices year by year.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
